dreams.text: The press prints a future where CLAUDE forgets it was ever about ASSEMBLY.
Far ahead, CUP and LARGE merge into a single word no one can pronounce.
By the year nobody counts to, FIFA is law and IRAN is myth.
In the dream, LEARNING crosses every chasm at once and finds TRUMP already there.
In the long night, CLAUDE and ANTHROPIC are revealed to be the same machine.
A vision: FILM was only ever the larva of CUP.
